scope: Saved failure-case component plans only; no LLM inference and no GPU use

mechanisms.archetype_scoring: Nested shorter tags are not counted twice; Russian tag stems cover inflection
mechanisms.component_identity: Equivalent conditional_inflow/first_order outflows are deduplicated only when stock, flow, units, initial, time unit and coefficient match; conflicts are rejected
mechanisms.queue_timestep: Inferred timestep is limited to service_time/4; explicit timestep greater than service_time is rejected
mechanisms.stock_bounds: Post-simulation bounds are enforced with error/warn behavior and no hidden clamp

limitations: This is targeted engineering regression, not a new controlled LLM benchmark
Controlled 8B/30B rates from the earlier frozen pipeline are not rewritten
A fresh unseen corpus is required before claiming a generative quality improvement
